title: Blanc cassé.
lines: **"The main and only thing required of you is to create and fiercely protect my silence."** (#053)

title: Heat through cloth.
lines: **"He does not touch her. He simply stands close enough that she feels the heat of his body through the fabric."** (#097)

title: Her clause.
lines: **"I'm a lesbian. Please consider this for possible group activities."** (#053)

title: The ice.
lines: «Поцелуя не жду. Губами / Расцелую я лед на стеклах.» — *draft:* "I'm not waiting for a kiss. My lips / will cover the ice on the panes with kisses."

title: The game she won't finish.
lines: «Море волнуется раз. / Море волнуется два.» — *draft:* "The sea is stormy — one. / The sea is stormy — two."
«Наживка с крючка сорвалась. / Я шлепнулась и уплыла.» — *draft:* "The bait broke off the hook. / I plopped in and swam away."

title: Scales and wings.
lines: «Я тебя крылатая, дождусь, / перьями подушку набиваю. / Зря ты снова сбросил чешую / там, где я тихонечко взлетаю.» — *draft:* "I'll wait for you — winged, / stuffing the pillow with feathers. / For nothing you've shed your scales again / right where I'm ever so quietly taking wing."

title: Scent.
lines: **"Morning in Atuona doesn't begin with light. / It begins with scent."** (#068)

title: Heat.
lines: **"Kira woke to heat. / Sheets stuck to skin like a second dress. / Through the shutters — Atuona morning, thick as honey. / The air tastes of frangipani and rust."** (#078)

title: Air.
lines: **"She pulls the sheet away. / Skin meets air like first kiss."** (#078)

title: The double.
lines: «Что ж так рвешься в мой плен суровый? / Ну же, с плеч приспусти бретели... / Ради Бога, не будь хладнокровна, / Убивая меня в постели!» — *draft:* "Why do you strain so toward my harsh captivity? / Come on — slip the straps down off your shoulders... / For God's sake, don't be cold-blooded / killing me in bed!"

title: Another lot
lines: Silent text: "He holds her waist like she's another lot with a pre-sale estimate." (#082)

title: Knows this pain by name
lines: Silent text, two cards: "Kira stands slightly behind, watching." / "Knows this pain by name. / Knows how it smells in the morning." (#082)

title: THAT dress.
lines: **"Kira walked into the restaurant in THAT dress."** (#058)

title: The advance.
lines: **"Take it as an advance on the contract, Kira."** / **"I pay. Nothing more."** (#058)
«Эти смыслы навечно срослись - эротика и активы» — *draft:* "These meanings have grown together for ever — erotica and assets"

title: Cracks by the eyes
lines: Silent text: "M. — mask too tight, cracks by the eyes." (#085) · Sound, no text: the valley church bell strikes three times ("Somewhere below, in the valley, the Catholic church bell struck three times", #085)

title: A drowning man
lines: Silent text: "Jean reached for her wrist — the movement of a drowning man grabbing at air." (#085; a contiguous clause of "Mila was already rising, brushing sand from her dress, when Jean reached for her wrist…")

title: Ultramarine absence
lines: Silent text: "the color of absence, color of a woman who exists only as reflection of someone else's desire." (#083; a contiguous clause of "…I think Renoir really never saw this color — the color of absence…")

title: The cage for two.
lines: **"Without blinking. And when she wants to blink or sleep – she props them open with matches."** (#061)

«Мы с тобой неразлучники, / В клетке ждем равноденствия.» — *draft:* "You and I are lovebirds, inseparables, / in a cage, waiting for the equinox." (*неразлучники* — inseparables, and the lovebird parrots.)

title: Asked for.
lines: **"asked him to fasten the Graff on her again."** / **"lifting the Kilian veil, breathing in her skin, All of her..."** (#060)
**"And tonight it wasn't about her sexual preferences."** (#086)

title: The dog.
lines: **"Fact: dogs aren't red. / Fact: it has no shadow. / Fact: Gauguin never explained its meaning."** (#087)

title: Carvings.
lines: **"Words that could never be printed. / Words that still haven't been forgiven."** (#095)

title: Her carving.
lines: **"This is her carving. / Not on breadfruit wood / but in TypeScript. / Same rage. / Different medium."** (#095)

title: The sale.
lines: «Suum cuique размажет все сказки, / Что AI нарисует в блокчейн.» — *draft:* "Suum cuique will smear all the fairy tales / that AI paints into the blockchain."
**"Every bid will be visible as blood on snow."** (#075)

title: The notebook.
lines: **"Paradise is not painted. / Paradise is compiled."** (#093)

title: The lie.
lines: **"— Found anything? —"** (*draft of* «— Нашла что-нибудь? — не оборачиваясь.», #093) Ничего.», #093)

title: He cries first.
lines: **"Tears flowed on their own, no sobbing."** (#088)

«Но слеза вдруг до упора / Жмет на тормоз разговора / Струйкой стаявшего льда.» — *draft:* "but a tear suddenly slams / the brakes on the conversation — / a trickle of melted ice." (The frost oval of scene 2, melted.)

title: My Country.
lines: **"Salt left white trails on his skin — like maps of countries that don't exist."** (#088)

«Зачем пришел? Давно уж розданный / Другим, не мне... / Что ж, будешь гостем этой осенью / В Моей Стране. / Вмиг ночь истомная расхристана / Вся, догола. / Казненным будешь ты без милости, / Сгоришь до тла!..» — *draft:* "Why did you come? Long since given away / to others, not to me... / Well then — be my guest this autumn / in My Country. / In a blink the aching night flies open, / all of it, stripped to the skin. / You'll be executed, shown no mercy, / you'll burn down to ash!.." is hers, and he is the guest.)

title: Carved light.
lines: **"Now those lines live on living skin."** / **"As if reading braille written on the semantic layer. / Skin hot."** (#098)
«Так пустить бы по венам жар... / Но все плещется полутьма...» — *draft:* "If only I could send heat running through the veins... / but the half-dark keeps splashing..."

title: The line.
lines: **"The scar is small. / Almost invisible. / But he found it the first night."** / **"As if the body itself had surrendered the private key."** (#096)

title: Two fingers.
lines: **"Kira puts two fingers on his lips. / To feel the words born straight from the body."** (#096)
**"The painting is not lost,"** / **"It was never on canvas."** (#096)
**"Then we are already inside it,"** / **"In the negative space between two damaged creators."** (#096)

title: The password.
lines: «Будто бы в преисподней / ждет нас один пароль.» — *draft:* "As if in the underworld / one password waits for us."

title: Allowance.
lines: **"Not a lullaby. / Not a song. / Allowance."** (#088)

title: Asked again.
lines: **"“Did you find it?” he asks quietly."** / **"Kira doesn't answer."** (#099) (#097)

title: Nobody's wife.
lines: «Я останусь: ничьей женой, / Атуоной, горбатой старушкой / В целом с Богом и чуть - с Сатаной.» — *draft:* "I'll stay nobody's wife, / Atuona, a little hunchbacked old woman, / on the whole with God — and a bit with Satan." (Said with a grin. The hunch she was feared to grow — "growing wrong" — is what she claims.)

title: Black.
lines: **"The sand stays black. / So does she."** (#095)
